source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed interim financial statements 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-4, review report (EY) p.5. Units differ: the SCI (three months p.8, six months p.10) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, no other revenue line. Revenue and expenses from note 3 (p.18, six months, both years). CSM roll-forward 4.2 p.21 (six months); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment relating to future service (CSM column); accretion = the profit-or-loss part of the insurance finance row (CSM column). New business 4.3 p.23. The tax line is an expense year to date (6,484,501 Baht: the 1Q2026 credit of 190,497 less the second-quarter expense of 6,674,998). The six-month SCI splits other income (2,102,461) and other expenses (547,511) slightly differently from 1Q2026 plus the three months (a 3,452 Baht reclassification; net nil). Insurance service result is a small loss year to date. RA release uses note 3 (5,148), not the AOC RA (7,819). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses + other expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.8).
